_readme: One entry per vendor. Fill in the fields as each program responds. 'status' controls what the site shows — leave it as 'not_applied' or 'pending' until you actually have a working link, so the site never shows a dead or non-affiliate link as if it were live.

_field_guide.status: 'not_applied' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'no_program' — controls what shows on the site
_field_guide.site_url: vendor's plain homepage — used as fallback when no affiliate link exists yet
_field_guide.tracking_type: 'link' | 'code' | 'link_plus_code' — how this vendor actually credits you
_field_guide.affiliate_link_base: your unique referral URL once approved, e.g. https://vendor.com/?ref=yourcode — leave null until you have it
_field_guide.promo_code: your discount/tracking code, if the vendor uses one — leave null until you have it
_field_guide.cookie_days: attribution window in days, from their terms — helps you know how long a click 'counts'
_field_guide.commission: rate or structure they quote you, as text — e.g. '10% for 12 months' or '15%, tiered to 25%'
_field_guide.guidelines_notes: any required disclaimer language or restricted phrasing they send you — paste it here so it's not just sitting in an email you'll lose track of
_field_guide.last_checked: date you last confirmed the link/code actually works

UltraLife.guidelines_notes: Site references a 'Partners Portal' — check there directly for application details.
UltraLife.shipping_info: Cold-pack shipping only (overnight/2-day air). Tiered by order size: $50 (small) to $110 (251+ peptides). 1-2 day processing.
UltraLife.testing_note: Manufactured in FDA-registered, NSF-certified, GMP-compliant facilities — but no independent third-party testing lab is named, unlike several other vendors here.

Core Peptides.guidelines_notes: Strict research-only policy — expect firm required-disclaimer language if approved.
Core Peptides.shipping_info: Free over $200. Flat rate ~$9.25-9.95 standard, or $49-49.95 overnight/priority.
Core Peptides.testing_note: Independent review describes COA coverage as 'mostly, but constantly being updated with new tests' — meaning not every product is tested yet.

Koi Peptides.guidelines_notes: Runs a qualified-buyer wholesale program (labs/CROs), not a consumer affiliate program. Likely won't fit this site's model — confirm before spending more time here.
Koi Peptides.shipping_info: Free shipping over $200. Same-day dispatch before 2PM CT, Mon-Fri.
Koi Peptides.testing_note: Dual-verified: tested in-house first, then independently re-run by an accredited external lab — one of the more thorough protocols in this group.

Southern Aminos.guidelines_notes: Multiple independent review sites already have disclosed affiliate links with them, so a program almost certainly exists — worth a direct email since no public application page was found.
Southern Aminos.testing_standard: 99.5% average purity across 124 independently tracked batches
Southern Aminos.testing_note: The most externally verified of any vendor here — tracked by independent third-party sites, not just self-reported. That same tracker also logged 2 historically underdosed batches, included here for honesty rather than omitted.

Purity Peptides.guidelines_notes: Apply at https://puritypeptides.is/affiliates/apply — 24-48hr review. Research Use Only framing required sitewide.
Purity Peptides.shipping_info: Ships to US and Canada only, no international. 1-2 day processing, then 5-10 days regular or 2-4 days express.
Purity Peptides.testing_note: No testing methodology, lab, or purity standard could be confirmed from their own site.

Royal Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-11. Site sells several actual prescription pharmaceuticals (HCG, HGH/Somatropin, Sildenafil) and SARMs (MK-677, Ostarine) alongside research peptides — those are deliberately excluded from the comparison, not just the usual TB-500/investigational-drug flags. Research Use Only framing required for everything that IS listed. GoAffPro (royalpeptides.goaffpro.com) confirmed 2026-09-16: Jackson — NO affiliation/promo coupon; dashboard reports “No coupon code found!”; promo_code null; tracking_type link. Commission via GoAffPro product affiliate links: affiliate_link_base https://royal-peptides.com/?ref=discount so resolveVendorLink merges ?ref=discount onto per-product shop URLs (e.g. https://royal-peptides.com/shop/5-amino-1mq/?ref=discount). Do not display a Royal coupon on the site.
Royal Peptides.payment_note: No credit cards accepted (confirmed via their Terms of Service).
Royal Peptides.shipping_info: 2-5 business days via UPS from California. Exact cost not published.
Royal Peptides.testing_note: Their own FAQ hedges: testing 'may include' HPLC/MS 'depending on the batch and documentation available' — less definitive than their marketing tagline implies.

BioIntegrity Research.guidelines_notes: Real, verified company — DBA of Triple Seven Distribution LLC. Publishes a public COA archive (strong trust signal). NOT the same as the 'BioIntegrity' name in the original spreadsheet, which remains unverified — do not conflate the two. No affiliate program contact made yet.
BioIntegrity Research.shipping_info: Calculated at checkout by weight/destination; cold-chain packaging included free. 2-3 day processing, ships via USPS/UPS/FedEx.
BioIntegrity Research.testing_note: Publishes a genuinely unusual permanent public COA archive (38 lots across 23 compounds, even sold-out ones) — but the testing lab isn't named, so independent/third-party status is unconfirmed.

Licensed Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-18. Referral link is path-based (/ref/CODE/), not query-string — site logic routes all Licensed Peptides clicks through this link as-is rather than combining with per-product URLs, to guarantee tracking isn't silently dropped.
Licensed Peptides.testing_standard: 99%+ HPLC purity; assay reported against vial specification
Licensed Peptides.testing_note: Names its testing laboratory and gives the accreditation certificate number, which can be checked against A2LA's public directory — the only vendor here to do so. Every vial carries a QR code linking to the certificate for that specific lot, and product pages publish the lot's own figures rather than a generic claim (MOTS-C lot: 99.08% purity, 11.00 mg assayed against a 10 mg specification, heavy metals non-detect). One caveat: a few product pages carry a placeholder rather than lot data, and a 'COA coming soon' page exists, so coverage is not yet complete across the catalogue.

Alpha Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-23. Referral link is path-based (/aff/863/), not query-string — site logic routes all Alpha Peptides clicks through this link as-is rather than combining with per-product URLs, same safety handling as Licensed Peptides. robots.txt confirmed clean (standard WooCommerce pattern, only blocks admin/cart-tracking paths) — eligible for the automated live price tracker.
Alpha Peptides.testing_standard: ≥99% purity floor; lots below floor rejected outright
Alpha Peptides.testing_note: Describes a five-test panel per lot (Qualitative ID, Percent Purity, Quantitative Assay, Heavy Metals, Conformity) and confirms identity by HPLC and MS before accepting a lot into inventory. COAs are not published on the site — they are supplied on request by email against a lot number, so a buyer cannot check before ordering.

Midwest Peptide.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-09-15. Query-string referral (?ref=DISCOUNT) — same handling as Royal Peptides: site logic merges the ref param onto per-product URLs when present. robots.txt confirmed clean (Allow: /; only blocks /admin/, /account/, /affiliate/, /checkout/, /cart, /api/) — eligible for the automated live price tracker. Trust/COA red flags (2026-09-15): Tesamorelin 10mg Chromate COA (batch MPTM001, chromate.org/verify MIDWEST7M91B) labeled 10mg but measured ~2.956mg (−70.4%); purity ~99% conforms but quantity fails — product still sold with that COA attached. GLP-1 SM (Semaglutide) coa_url points to a Freedom Diagnostics COA that is actually for Semax (lot MPSX001) — wrong document on the Semaglutide product; Semax coa_url is null. Lighter trust context: Trustpilot ~4.5–4.8 mostly positive, but the affiliate programme incentivises Trustpilot reviews (500 pts); domain relatively new; mixed third-party risk scores — the COA quantity fail and wrong-document attachment are the main flags.
Midwest Peptide.testing_lab: Freedom Diagnostics + Chromate (named; public verify portals)
Midwest Peptide.testing_standard: High purity claimed on published COAs; net content reported on Chromate COAs where present
Midwest Peptide.testing_note: COA RED FLAGS — not a clean testing story. (1) Tesamorelin 10mg Chromate COA batch MPTM001 (chromate.org/verify MIDWEST7M91B): labeled 10mg, measured ~2.956mg (−70.4%); purity ~99% conforms but quantity fails — product still sold with that failing COA attached. (2) GLP-1 SM (Semaglutide) coa_url points to a Freedom Diagnostics COA that is actually for Semax (lot MPSX001) — wrong document on the Semaglutide product; Semax coa_url is null. Labs (Freedom Diagnostics + Chromate) are named and publicly verifiable, which supports tier 2 on lab-identity verifiability alone — do not read the tier as a clean bill of health given the quantity fail and mismatched COA.

American Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-08-24. Listed on probation 2026-09-15 (testing_tier 3; Peptigrity 50/100, 0 reviews; Finnrick independent tests thin). GLP SKUs included per Jackson. robots_allows true for /products/. Domain lock: americanpeptides.us / www.americanpeptides.us ONLY — do not confuse with buyamericanpeptides.com (Legion Peptides) or americanpeptide.com (singular, unrelated). CUTOVER 2026-09-23: Discount Peptides seat din489828 — affiliate attribution is LINK-ONLY via bg_ref=jcLXZhD8Nk (affiliate_link_base https://www.americanpeptides.us?bg_ref=jcLXZhD8Nk). tracking_type link; promo_code null; commission via bg_ref only; no coupon on site. Do not invent DISCOUNT. Old JACKSON101302 seat deprecated for site clicks (do not show JACKSON101302 as a checkout code). resolveVendorLink merges ?bg_ref=jcLXZhD8Nk onto per-product URLs (query-style, same as Royal/Offline/Midwest). Christmas-in-September campaign ended Sat Sep 26, 2026 9:00am CT — Day 12 Santa’s Last Run (25% sitewide + Santa’s Sack $150+) cleared from Active deal and live_prices; no Day 13; do not carry the $150+ Santa’s Sack threshold forward. Still active (temporary storefront promo): SPRAY20 — 20% off every liquid spray (banner/email; new 10 mL atomized sprays featured) until Sunday Sep 27, 2026 midnight CT. Code SPRAY20 (exact casing); email also says discount may apply automatically when shopping from email links. SPRAY20 is a vendor storefront promo (guidelines-only) — not our affiliate code; affiliate attribution remains bg_ref only. Do not invent spray live_prices — email-observed spray SKUs (NAD+ 500mg 10mL, REM Blend, PT-141 10mg 10mL, Glutathione 500mg 10mL, Adamax 10mg 10mL, Oxytocin 10mg 10mL) are not in American product_urls catalogue; leave guidelines-only. Catalogue nasal sprays (Selank/Semax) also guidelines-only pending verified PDP onSale strikethrough. Do not claim SPRAY20 stacks with anything. Source: shipping@americanpeptides.us Wed Sep 23 ~5:57am PT subject “New products have arrived — 20% off with SPRAY20”. Do not invent other onSale prices.
American Peptides.payment_note: Per Terms of Service; Peptigrity profile listing crypto-only is incomplete vs Terms.
American Peptides.shipping_info: Free shipping on orders $300+. Typical 24–48 business hours dispatch; Standard vs Expedited at checkout. Shipping SLA copy on site has CT vs EST inconsistencies — do not over-promise speed.
American Peptides.testing_standard: ≥99% purity claimed; lot-matched COA every batch claimed
American Peptides.testing_note: Named third-party lot COAs published with verify-by-lot — fits testing_tier 3. Peptigrity 50/100 with 0 verified reviews; Finnrick independent published results thin/absent as of ~2026-08. Peptigrity HPLC rows appear aligned with vendor Bioviridian certificates (documentation strength), not proven independent blind-buy. Probationary listing; do not upgrade to tier 4 without DP-owned or Finnrick-style blind results.

Offline Peptides.guidelines_notes: Approved 2026-09-16. Listed with retail prices only — Jackson: NEVER surface deals/sales/onSale/EOS3/B2G1/End-of-Summer for Offline (terms void commission when promo discounts apply). AffiliateWP query-style deep-link confirmed 2026-09-15: affiliate_link_base https://offlinepeptides.com/?ref=discountspeptides@gmail.com so resolveVendorLink merges ?ref= onto product URLs (affwp_ref / visit cookies after marketing consent; referral_var=ref; affiliate_id 119). Fallback entry URL still valid: https://offlinepeptides.com/ref/discountspeptides@gmail.com/ . promo_code null until Offline confirms dedicated partner code AND Jackson says show it. Programme excludes coupon/deal sites — accepted for price comparison only without promoting their sales. testing_tier 3. COA RED FLAG: GHK-Cu underfill. HGH excluded. robots_allows true.
Offline Peptides.commission: 20% new customer / 10% lifetime returning (public terms; FAQ cites 15%/365 conflict — confirm on dashboard)
payment_methods: Major digital payment platforms / standard online processors (availability at checkout)
Offline Peptides.payment_note: Statement descriptor OFFLINEPEPTIDES.COM per FAQ. Exact card/ACH/crypto matrix not fully enumerated on policy pages.
Offline Peptides.shipping_info: US only; typically 1–2 business days processing with tracking. Free Priority Shipping on orders over $250 (site banner). Delivery estimates not guaranteed.
Offline Peptides.testing_note: Public third-party COAs on /coa/ (Krause Analytical, Freedom Diagnostics; HPLC + MS). COA RED FLAG: GHK-Cu 100mg lot OP-CU100-0626 (Krause) shows chromatographic purity >99.9% but measured content ~13.2 mg vs 100 mg label claim — underfill. Do not market Offline as content-verified without noting this. testing_tier 3.

Orbitrex Peptide.guidelines_notes: Approved GoAffPro 2026-09. Domain MUST be orbitrexpeptide.is only (clone domains exist). GLP-coded SKUs EXCLUDED from listings (G2-TRZ=Tirzepatide-class per vendor schema; 3G-RT/1G-SGT coded). Public COA library. testing_tier 2.
Orbitrex Peptide.testing_lab: Named labs vary by lot (Freedom Diagnostics, TrustPointe, ILS, Kovera, Chromate cited in secondary sources; summary UI does not always name lab)
Orbitrex Peptide.testing_standard: Public batch COA library (~170 certificates / 56 products); 99%+ purity marketing
Orbitrex Peptide.testing_note: Public COA library at /coas/ with batch purity/endotoxins/heavy metals/sterility columns. Finnrick independent dataset exists. Lab names not always front-and-center on summary UI → tier 2, not 1.
